results.text: Metabolic efficiency of the liver in patients with breast cancer as determined by pharmacokinetics of phenazone. Phenazone pharmacokinetics was determined in 24 healthy women and in 39 women with breast cancer; in the latter before and after antineoplastic treatment. The mean phenazone half-life time (t0.5) was significantly shorter in patients with breast cancer (8.880 +/- 2.5585 h) than in healthy persons (12.024 +/- 3.8486 h, P less than 0.001). Pharmacokinetics-Based Safety Evaluation in Half-Dose Verteporfin Photodynamic Therapy. Prediction of the optimal dose of exenatide in patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus with renal impairment using physiologically based pharmacokinetic modeling.
